title: Aaron Maher (AUS) vs Liam Neyland (AUS) [Bout 1]
tactical_note: Aaron Maher, with a strong standing frame and a good ground/Scramble, can exploit the opportunity to gain an advantage in the first round. His level-Change shots and mean spine lean indicate a balanced and stable approach, while his elbow flexion and knee flexion indicate a well-timed and controlled move. This combination of skills allows Maher to capitalize on the pressure and create a strong opening for the opponent.
